operation.summary: Analysis of what left the phone, in one call: a plain-language headline, totals, trends by hour or day, the biggest destinations, agents and calls, destinations first seen in the window, failures, and for each destination the data categories, purposes and agents it received

query.name: destination
query.description: Text in the host or service name, e.g. met.no, jev, relay

query.name: agent
query.description: Comma list of agent names or ids; me; phone or owner for calls nobody's agent caused

query.name: category
query.description: Comma list of data categories, any of them, e.g. location_1km,image,install_id

query.name: q
query.description: Text in the purpose, path or sent preview

query.name: bucket
query.description: Trend step: hour or day (default hour for windows up to 48 h)

operation.returns: headline ("Since 00:00 today: 7 calls sent 4.9 KB to 3 destinations: ..."), window{since, until, bucket}, totals{calls, failed, bytes_sent, bytes_received, categories[], destinations, agents}, by_destination[{service, host, calls, failed, bytes, categories[], purposes[], agents[], first_at, last_at, new}], by_category[{category, destinations[], agents[]}], by_agent[{agent, destinations[]}], by_purpose[], by_day[], by_time[], biggest{destinations[], agents[], calls[]}, new_destinations[{host, first_at, categories[]}], failures{count, by_destination[], by_error[], recent[]}, recording{on, changed_at, changed_by}, scope, coverage

bucket.description: Trend step: hour or day (default hour for windows up to 48 h)

q.description: Text in the purpose, path or sent preview

agent.description: Comma list of agent names or ids; me; phone or owner for calls nobody's agent caused

destination.description: Text in the host or service name, e.g. met.no, jev, relay

category.description: Comma list of data categories, any of them, e.g. location_1km,image,install_id
